decision_rule.basis: 3x the MEASURED ARM U 3-seed spread (0.1341484 px), i.e. 0.40 px -- the level at which an improvement is separable from run-to-run noise. Old 1.0 px bar was calibrated against a 4.2 px gap to the reference; that gap is now 1.06 px, so a 1.0 px bar would count only reaching the reference as success.
decision_rule.compared_against: ARM U 3-seed MEAN 2.3732058 (not seed-0 best 2.2866369; single-seed ARM V vs best-of-three ARM U would be unfair in our favour)

eval_config_note: frozen_eval.score_checkpoint hardcodes StereoNetConfig() (downsample_levels=4, num_disparities=12, cost_volume_shift=none, regression_normalize=False), which would evaluate ARM V weights through a different forward graph (and a mismatched state dict) than trained. Faithful scores use a line-for-line mirror of score_checkpoint with StereoNetConfig(downsample_levels=3, num_disparities=24, cost_volume_shift="right", regression_normalize=True); dataset split, GT scale, metrics, and contract guard are imported unmodified from phase1.harness.frozen_eval.
frozen_variables: masked smooth-L1 beta=1.0, valid gt>0 and gt<184
split hailo_calib 160 train / hailo_val 40 eval, overlap 0
hypothesis: The cost volume samples disparity every 16 full-resolution pixels over 12 candidates (0..176 px). Halving the matching stride to 1/8 and doubling the candidates to 24 gives 8 px spacing over 0..184 px -- finer evidence and fuller range -- reducing frozen-contract EPE by at least 0.4 px versus the ARM U 3-seed mean 2.3732058.
intervention: StereoNetConfig(downsample_levels=3, num_disparities=24, cost_volume_shift=right, regression_normalize=True) vs ARM U downsample_levels=4, num_disparities=12. Stride halves and candidate count doubles TOGETHER so the disparity RANGE stays about constant (176 -> 184 px) and only the SAMPLING DENSITY changes. No source change needed (both knobs already honoured end to end); no default changed; no other hyperparameter changed.

pretraining_checks.params_note: NOT parameter-free: 397,954 vs ARM U 423,586. The entire delta (-25,632) is the removed fourth 5x5 downsample conv (32*32*25+32); aggregation/refinement/regression are untouched (num_disparities changes the cost depth axis, not channel counts). State dict has 70 keys vs 72 (one fewer conv = 2 fewer weight/bias keys); strict_ok true under the matching config.
pretraining_checks.step_time_note: synthetic (random tensors, compute only) underestimates; smoke (real dataloader + val curve) extrapolates ~4130 s. Both far below the 4 h limit, so the full run proceeded.

best_final_note: Best-val snap (ep 180) and final-epoch snap (ep 199) carry different weights; both frozen scores recorded. Best 1.8903392, final 1.9043133.

stereo_path_liveness.verdict: STEREO PATH LIVE -- substituting shift=none at eval time changes the final output by up to ~69.2 px (full-40 EPE collapses to 39.55), so the disparity search contributes.
